ev.q: From December 1997 through May 1998, 95 confirmed rubella cases were identified in Westchester County (attack rate: 10.7 per 100,000 population)
Eighty-eight (93%) patients were foreign born; the median time in the United States was 4 years
79 (83%) were laboratory-confirmed and 16 (17%) were linked epidemiologically
95 confirmed rubella cases were identified in Westchester County (attack rate: 10.7 per 100,000 population)
During this period, 333 cases were reported in the United States.
Among foreign-born patients, 34 (39%) were born in Mexico and 31 (35%) in Guatemala.
This report describes a rubella outbreak in Westchester County, New York
